items.statement: Aim to achieve FY25 profitability levels of INR16 crore PBT and INR12 crore PAT in FY26

items.statement: Committed to maintaining industry-leading EBITDA margins of around 50%

items.quote: If you look at that, yes, the steel market is bound to grow. And of course, India's per capita consumption of steel is nowhere close to per capita consumption in developed countries. So, there is no doubt that steel products, steel requirement in India is bound to grow.

items.quote: As a result, the Indian outbound student market reached an estimated value of US330 billion in 2023, and is projected to grow at a CAGR of over 10% through 2030.

items.statement: Revenue 90%+ from university commissions (first-year fees); adding pathway programs, domestic college acquisitions, visa processing, AI assessments, loan tie-ups (Credelia, SBI, Axis)
items.quote: So, the major revenue income is the commissions from the universitics and colleges which we get for recruiting students for them. That is the highest, like you can say above 90% would be that only.

items.statement: Canada ~60-70% of revenue; UK, Germany, US make up remaining 20-30%; 32+ university tie-ups in non-Canada geographies
items.quote: See, I'l tell you Canada s still 60, 70% of our revermie. So rest all other are 30% of the revemue, 20% to 30% of the revenue.

items.statement: Acquisition of Indian college and regional immigration consultant in advanced stages; part of IPO proceeds allocation
items.quote: We are in very advanced stage of basically acquiring acquisition of colleges and one of the broker is one of the immigration consultant as well.

items.statement: Commission collection cycle 90-180 days; receivables spike at year-end due to January intake; working capital cycle not 60-65 days
items.quote: No, no. The commission cycle ranges from like maybe 90 to 180 days.

items.statement: Next 3-4 branches: Mumbai, Pune, Indore, Rajkot; Hyderabad hiring done; East/South expansion via video counseling launch within 60 days
items.quote: I think the next three to four branches would definitely include, one of them would be Mumbai. Yes. So Mumbai, Pune and in MP also Indore is one of the branch we are looking at.

items.statement: Franchise revenue only 2-3% of total; next 15 branches will be COCO model; franchise module development just started
items.quote: Right now, if you talk about today, we are majorly in COCO, right? But it would be a very, you can say, cautious call. Once we develop this particular model, we will get into a FOCO as well. But right now, the next 15 branches, we are going to open in a COCO model only.
